summary.text: Liz Bishop is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 76 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Amy Murri Briel (D).
Bishop is a banker and the elected La Salle city clerk.

paragraphs.text: Bishop was born in Sterling, Illinois, graduated from La Salle-Peru Township High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Carleton College in 1982.
Her career experience includes working as a banker.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Bishop said she serves as a precinct committeeman, previously served as a Deputy State Central Committeeman for the Illinois Republican Party and is a director of a local political action committee.
She said she was most recently elected La Salle city clerk.
Bishop won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
She listed affordability and public safety among her key campaign messages, saying she wants to eliminate unnecessary state spending and support law enforcement and victims' rights.
